businessContracts.name: battle timed dialogue clears and continues without another confirmation
businessContracts.legalInput: Typed sourceCommands with contiguous messageIndex100..102, RestoreScreen and bottom portrait8; SLF title/timed string/null/following body. No state or command mutation by the test.
businessContracts.independentOracle: SDLPal text.c:1542-1554 resets nCurrentDialogLine to0 after ~NN; text.c:1770 waits only for count>0. Therefore null after ~ cannot demand Confirm; body is removed while title and portrait survive. The actual English pack has10 null-after-~ occurrences, including start1..4 with this exact timed string. Short final line intentionally isolates clearing from line-wrap behavior.
businessContracts.dedupe: The existing explicit clear case requires Confirm after ordinary body; this added case forbids that extra Confirm after a timed body.

businessContracts.name: battle narration clear after timeout adds no empty dialog or extra wait
businessContracts.caller: runScript(runtimeMode:battle) -> translated queue -> narration host timeout -> clearPage with no active dialog -> next narration
businessContracts.legalInput: Real createBattleLifecycleFixture/startBattle, typed narration command and translated body/null/body; input is empty throughout.
businessContracts.independentOracle: SDLPal text.c:1663-1710 auto-closes narration after1.4s. A following clear is not a new message and must not create an empty box or additional wait. The next two host ticks consume clear and begin the following actual narration.
businessContracts.dedupe: Existing exploration narration case exercises timeout and key completion, not the battle no-active-box clear path.

dimensions.B: The sole added comment explains the narration duration units (35 battle ticks at40ms) from primary timing rather than restating queue internals.
dimensions.C: Each case tests one clear contract. Shared preparation remains in the established input and battle fixture helpers; no product responsibilities move into tests.
dimensions.D: Reuses createBattleLifecycleFixture, runScript, tickBattleDialog and existing source span. Repeated setup is short and semantic; no generic flag-driven harness added.
dimensions.E: 11 native green cases, preserving all9 originals; one selected business negative control fails precisely at the phantom empty dialog assertion, after successful collection and execution. Ten unselected cases in that counter receive no execution credit.
dimensions.F: Names identify timed/body clear and auto-closed narration clear. Assertions observe visible body/title/portrait/absence of phantom box; initial real-wrap fixture mismatch was corrected and raw failure preserved.
dimensions.G: Only60 inserted test lines. No skip/only directives, timeout relaxation, mocks, new exports, retired tests, production changes, baseline edits or coverage suppressions.
dimensions.H: Real tick APIs permit deterministic no-key time progression and direct observation of dialog state. No test-only product hooks or private API exposure introduced.
